title: Memory
description: A single media Memory linked to a Profile. Stored as a Firestore document under `profiles/{profileId}/memories/{memoryId}`. The `contextText` field is mandatory by product design — every media item must carry a written story.

memoryId.description: Unique identifier. Generated client-side (UUID v4) before upload.

profileId.description: Foreign key linking this Memory to its parent Profile.

mediaType.description: Type of the media file. Drives player/viewer selection in the UI.

mediaUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the media file in S3 (retrieved via presigned URL in Phase 2).

storageClass.description: S3 storage class. Lifecycle rules will automatically migrate old memories to GLACIER_DEEP_ARCHIVE.

contextText.description: MANDATORY: The written story explaining the significance of this memory. The app blocks upload if empty.

contextAudioUrl.description: Optional: HTTPS URL to an audio narration clip supplementing the written context.

capturedDate.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for when the photo/video/audio was originally captured.

example.contextText: Este fue el último verano que pasamos juntos en Cartagena. Abuela insistió en que nos tomáramos esta foto al atardecer. Nunca olvidaré su sonrisa ese día.
